link_notes: Sources are thin: abstract and a short README only, no paper full text.

open_release.rationale: ERGM is a network model-fitting package; nothing frames its simulations as a releasable substitute for data.

pipeline_testing.rationale: No test-data or format framing in the abstract or README.

ml_augmentation.rationale: No predictive-model training or augmentation framing in the abstract or README.

statistical_replication.rationale: The package simulates new networks from a fitted ERGM and assesses how well the fit captures the data's characteristics.

quotes.text: simulating new network data sets from a fitted ERGM using Markov chain Monte Carlo; and assessing how well a fitted ERGM does at capturing characteristics of a particular network data set.

causal_inference.rationale: ERGMs are statistical models of network structure; the abstract and README have no causal or intervention framing.

education.rationale: The README is thin and shows no teaching material, but the full paper was not available.

benchmarking.rationale: The README is thin and shows no use as a baseline or benchmark, but the full paper was not available.

imbalance_correction.rationale: No class or imbalance framing in the abstract or README.
